title: Multicultural Arts Center

services.name: Venue Rental
services.desc: Items and services included with rental of the Theater include: One (1) Production Staff member, static show lighting, basic sound (computer/phone plug-in, and up to 5 mics) 5 metal music stands and WiFi access. All other items must be rented from the Multicultural Arts Center (see pricing below), or from an outside rental vendor. The caterers on our approved list are extremely knowledgeable about our venue and will provide you with exceptional fare and service! Michelin-recognized restaurant, drawing inspiration from Spanish and Japanese

services.name: Community Arts Rentals
services.desc: We offer sliding-scale rentals of our theater and studio spaces for artists and organizations to rehearse, perform, record, or host

gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Fostering cultural and creative equity through the visual and performing arts The Multicultural Arts Center is a place for artists and performers to share their stories through music, dance, poetry, theater and the visual arts to foster conversation around issues of identity, race and equity. These stories reflect the incredible lived experiences of our community.
